description: Superseded 2026-07-24 (see NOTES.md, "Solution Builder popup replaces Find Your Fit" entry): the old 3-question flow (Step 1/2/3 tabs) and its case-study/solution routing repeaters have been removed entirely, not left dormant. This options page now controls only the popup's modal shell copy (eyebrow/heading/subheading/trigger label) — the popup shell itself, open/close mechanics, auto-open timing, and progress-dot styling are unchanged. The 7 questions it now asks (footer.php) come directly from inc/solution-builder.php's option-list functions, the same single source of truth the dedicated /solution-builder/ page uses, not from ACF — so there's no separate question content to edit here.
